test_title: PYST 42: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 6 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Identify the option figure that when placed in the blank space completes the pattern in the given question figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/727bd4d6a2e3a15f282afced608cce99d1f3ea643814f86af76cbf739030baac.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43b8f6f2b7df052820030593bbcf9e7ab67612f1e716bac7deffd136d6613998.png] 

1) In first row figures are rotated 45⁰ clockwise :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c46dfc25772139eeab10d53f4acbc0bb296d32d7c6f6db2369480fcc1dee7046.png] 

2) In second row figures are rotated 45⁰ clockwise :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bfba159f482a62f8b09706b9d3ad3b343236540aeaf6df7d7d96ce660f074a5.png] 

3) In third row figures should rotate 450 in anticlockwise so we get 1st figure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f44faf8bf1adf86e46527a72be8e1465976505edd3d3518ae149cab736df5779.png] 

Thus, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
